draft.text: You came because you have been having shortness of breath for a few months.
You also notice wheezing more often, especially when you are outside or at home.
During the exam, we heard faint wheezing when you breathe out.
There were no other signs of problems, and tests like a chest X-ray and lung function test came back normal.
Your symptoms are not linked to specific times, seasons, or activities.
You use an inhaler when needed, but it does not seem to fully relieve your symptoms.
We will discuss next steps to help understand what might be causing your symptoms.

unverified_summary.text: You came because you have been feeling short of breath for a few months.
We found that your shortness of breath is not linked to specific times, seasons, or activities.
You do not have chest pain, cough, or fatigue.
You also do not feel dizzy, lightheaded, or faint.
You do not have trouble breathing when lying down.
The cause of your shortness of breath is not clear.
Tests like a chest X-ray and lung function test were normal.
You do not have wheezing that is very obvious, but there is a slight wheezing sound when you breathe out.
We will discuss next steps to help understand the cause of your symptoms.
